How to use Riva: Smart Reception

One person businesses and small teams that lose calls while working: plumbers, electricians, clinics, salons, restaurants, garages. Private for now.

Read the bookContact

WalkthroughMotion design, real screens

It plays by itself. Tap a dot or the arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01Get started

Five steps, five minutes.

1

Open the site and talk to the demo: it answers like Riva would.

2

Read How it works: a call is answered, transcribed, summarised; the contact is created; the quote is drafted.

3

Pick your industry page to see the scripts for your trade.

4

Check the pricing, then press Book a call.

5

A specialist deploys Riva on your existing number; you approve quotes with one tap.

03Tips
  • Keep your number; Riva sits in front of it.
  • Approve quotes from your phone between two jobs.
  • Both languages are automatic; the caller chooses.
04FAQ
Does Riva replace my receptionist?

It answers when nobody can, and books, quotes and follows up.

Which languages?

English and French, switched by the caller.

Do I need technical skills?

No. A specialist deploys and manages it.

Is it live?

Private for now; book a call to be first.
